page.layout: One centred title page, all lines in one column. Below the title lines: a woodcut engraving (a medallion with a standing armoured figure, with circular inscription around it), then the printer's line and the year. No running head, page number or catchword.

l.i: S. theol. doctorem, atque apud Bre-

page.notes: The woodcut engraving in the centre shows a standing armoured figure holding a sword and a shield, set in a medallion with scrollwork. The circular inscription around it could not be read reliably; the two arcs are marked illegible and no letters are guessed. The "2" in the top right corner, the handwritten "(p. 365 i.)" and the handwritten "815.29 Th. (2)" are marks added by hand or by the library, so they are left out. The printed text is shown as set, including "ejusq; " and "atq; " with their semicolons.
